package.title: Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates
package.description: Drag-and-drop email template editor component (TmEmailTemplateEditor) for Tempo.Blazor. Visual MJML editor with full MJML 4 parity, bidirectional MJML import/export, Scriban variable templating and live preview. Built entirely on Tempo.Blazor components.

gettingStarted.title: Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates
gettingStarted.overview: Drag-and-drop email template editor component (TmEmailTemplateEditor) for Tempo.Blazor. Visual MJML editor with full MJML 4 parity, bidirectional MJML import/export, Scriban variable templating and live preview. Built entirely on Tempo.Blazor components.

items.description: A single editable scalar property of a model object, with reflective get/set.
The kind of editor a property maps to.
Enumerates the editable scalar properties of email model objects via reflection.
Editor for named MJML mj-class definitions. Each class exposes its attribute key/value map (edited via TmEmailKeyValueEditor), and new classes can be added by name or removed.

parameters.name: Attributes
parameters.description: The head attributes containing the named-class definitions (mj-class).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: The head attributes containing the named-class definitions (mj-class).

items.description: Modal dialog that renders the current email document as read-only source, toggling between generated MJML and the document's JSON representation for copying.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: The document to export.

parameters.name: Show
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

items.description: Editor for MJML mj-html-attributes selectors. Each selector has a target path and a key/value list of attributes (edited via TmEmailKeyValueEditor); selectors can be added or removed.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: The mj-html-attributes selectors (round-trip only; not rendered by Mjml.Net).

parameters.name: Selectors
parameters.description: The mj-html-attributes selectors (round-trip only; not rendered by Mjml.Net).

items.description: Modal dialog for importing an email template from MJML or JSON, via pasted text or a dropped file. Shows parse errors or a summary preview (section and warning counts) and confirms the import into the editor.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised with the imported document when the user confirms.

parameters.name: OnImport
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

parameters.name: Show
parameters.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

items.description: Editor for a string-to-string dictionary, presenting each entry as an editable key/value pair with add and remove controls. Rebuilds the dictionary in place on every change.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The dictionary being edited (rebuilt in place on every change).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: The dictionary being edited (rebuilt in place on every change).

items.description: Generic editor for an ordered list of model items. Each item is edited via TmEmailObjectFields, and the list supports adding, removing, and reordering (move up/down) entries.

parameters.name: ItemPrimary
parameters.description: The list of sub-elements being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The list of sub-elements being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Property names shown first for each item.

items.description: Reflection-driven form that edits the scalar properties of a target model object. Named primary fields are shown first, with the remaining properties collapsed under an "Advanced" section, and any property can be excluded when handled elsewhere.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Property names shown above the "Advanced" section, in order.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Property names to omit (rendered by a dedicated editor elsewhere).

parameters.name: Primary
parameters.description: The model object whose scalar properties are edited.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The model object whose scalar properties are edited.

items.description: Context-sensitive property inspector for the currently selected section, column, or block. Renders the element's common fields plus type-specific editors such as rich-text content, raw HTML, image upload, and variable insertion.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document being edited.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: The selected node id (block, section or column); null edits the document settings.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Host-provided variables, merged with those extracted from the document.

parameters.name: SelectedId
parameters.description: The document being edited.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Raised after any property changes.

items.description: Grid editor for a table block's cells. Lets the user edit each cell's text, mark rows as header rows, and add or remove rows and columns.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: The table block being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: The table block being edited (mutated in place).

items.description: Central editing canvas that renders an email document's sections, columns, and blocks. Supports selection, drag-and-drop, keyboard navigation, and per-section toolbars for adding columns and moving, duplicating, or deleting a section.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document being displayed.

parameters.name: DragActive
parameters.description: Raised after the document is mutated by a block/section/column action.

parameters.name: OnBlockDragStart
parameters.description: Raised when a block is dropped into a column at an index.

parameters.name: OnDocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the selection changes.

parameters.name: OnDropInColumn
parameters.description: Whether a drag is in progress (shows drop zones between blocks).

parameters.name: SelectedId
parameters.description: The document being displayed.

parameters.name: SelectedIdChanged
parameters.description: The currently selected node id (block, column or section), if any.

items.description: Top-level MJML email template editor. Combines a toolbar (undo/redo, preview, validate, import, export, save with autosave status) with a three-pane layout: a block toolbox, a drag-and-drop canvas, and a property panel for the selected element.

parameters.name: AutoSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a save.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Gets or sets the edited document. Two-way bindable via DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the document changes (for @bind-Document).

parameters.name: OnAutoSave
parameters.description: Auto-save configuration; when enabled, edits are saved after a debounce interval.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Host-provided variables offered by the variable picker (merged with extracted ones).

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the document changes (for @bind-Document).

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Raised by auto-save with the current document.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Clock used for auto-save debouncing (overridable in tests).

items.description: Live preview of the rendered email with desktop/mobile device toggles and HTML/plain-text view switching. Includes a sample-data editor (with generation) for resolving template variables and surfaces any rendering warnings.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document to preview.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Optional variable data (JSON). When null, sample data is generated from the template.

parameters.name: VariablesJson
parameters.description: The document to preview.

items.description: Palette of email building blocks from the block registry, grouped by category, plus a set of column-layout presets. Clicking or dragging a block raises the add/drag callbacks, and choosing a preset inserts a new section.

parameters.name: OnAddBlock
parameters.description: Raised when a block is chosen (clicked) to be added.

parameters.name: OnAddSection
parameters.description: Raised when a block drag starts (for drag-and-drop onto the canvas).

parameters.name: OnDragBlockStart
parameters.description: Raised when a block is chosen (clicked) to be added.

items.description: Lists validation findings for the email document, combining structural checks with Scriban template-syntax validation of every template-bearing string. Each finding is severity-tagged and, when clicked, navigates to the offending node.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: The document to validate.

parameters.name: OnNavigate
parameters.description: The document to validate.

items.description: Searchable list of the template variables available to the document. Selecting a variable raises OnInsert with its {{ path }} token, and collection variables are badged so array bindings are recognizable.

parameters.name: OnInsert
parameters.description: The variables available to insert (extracted from the document plus host-provided).

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: The variables available to insert (extracted from the document plus host-provided).

items.description: Configures the editor's debounced auto-save behaviour.

members.name: Enabled
members.description: Gets or sets whether auto-save is enabled.

members.name: Interval
members.description: Gets or sets the debounce interval after the last change before auto-saving.

items.description: Marker type identifying the Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates UI assembly. Used as the assembly anchor for localization resource resolution and component discovery.

members.name: Assembly
members.description: Gets the assembly that contains the email template editor components.

items.description: DI registration for the Tempo.Blazor email template editor UI.
Localization accessor for the email template editor UI. Backed by IStringLocalizer<TmEmailResources>; hosts may replace it to fully control strings.
Marker class for the Tempo.Blazor.EmailTemplates UI string resources. Used with IStringLocalizer<TmEmailResources> and the accompanying .resx files (English default, Czech and French).
In-memory, block-level clipboard for the editor. Copy stores an independent snapshot; paste returns a fresh copy with new identifiers each time, so repeated pastes never collide.

members.name: Copy
members.description: Stores an independent copy of the block on the clipboard.

members.name: Paste
members.description: Returns a fresh copy (with new ids) of the clipboard block, or null if empty.

members.name: CanPaste
members.description: Gets whether a block is available to paste.

items.description: Maintains undo/redo history of document snapshots. Each pushed state is a deep, independent copy, the depth is bounded, and rapid edits sharing a coalesce key within a short window merge into a single undo step (so typing is one undo, not one per keystroke).

members.name: Initialize
members.description: Resets the history to a single baseline state.

members.name: Push
members.description: Records a new document state. When coalesceKey matches the previous push and falls within the coalesce window, it replaces the current state instead of adding a new step.

members.name: Redo
members.description: Moves one step forward and returns an independent copy of that state, or null.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Moves one step back and returns an independent copy of that state, or null.

members.name: CanRedo
members.description: Gets whether a redo is available.

members.name: CanUndo
members.description: Gets whether an undo is available.
